note: The announcement bar at the top of every guest page (holiday and Tết hours, the next event). Each announcement shows from show_from until show_until, Hanoi time: write them with their +07:00, e.g. 2027-02-01T00:00:00+07:00. The pages switch it on and off by themselves at those times, without a rebuild; one that has ended can be deleted. id: lowercase letters, digits and -, unique (a dismissed bar stays dismissed by its id). link is optional: a page on the site (/visit-us/) or a full address, with link_text and link_text_vi. Example: {"id": "tet-2027", "show_from": "2027-01-30T00:00:00+07:00", "show_until": "2027-02-11T00:00:00+07:00", "text": "We're closed from 5 to 10 February for Tết.", "text_vi": "Sol nghỉ Tết từ 05/02 đến 10/02.", "link": "/visit-us/", "link_text": "Opening hours", "link_text_vi": "Giờ mở cửa"}
note_vi: Every *_vi field is the Vietnamese twin of the field above it.
